paper.note: The paper's tool count and coverage figures describe v1.0.0. The counts of this snapshot are measured separately, and the statement coverage measured for this release is recorded under `coverage`.

measurement.method: Statement coverage (coverage.py) of the Python code under APIs/, tests excluded, from `coverage run -m pytest` followed by `coverage report`, run in the release's folder (api_runtime/v1.1.0) with the folder's own coverage settings. `fileListSha256` is the SHA-256 of the folder's SHA256SUMS.

catalogDifference.note: The paper reports 809 benchmark tools; this source snapshot exposes 827 benchmark tools plus 15 framework helpers (authentication and shared utilities).

scope: All .py files under APIs/ of the release's API files: every benchmark service, its tests, authentication, and shared utilities. All 36 Schemas/*.json files retained. No runtime databases, task/user data, compiled bytecode, .env files, scripts outside APIs/, or evaluation results are exported. No source code is executed.
